_about: Evaluation set for the Tax Document Q&A (RAG) module. expected_file = source PDF in ingest/data; expected_pages = 1-based physical PDF pages where the answer is stated (verified by reading the PDF). Out-of-scope questions have no expected source and should be refused.

questions.question: Is a foreign employee who works in Malaysia for less than 60 days taxed on their employment income?
questions.answer_notes: Exempt if employment period in Malaysia does not exceed 60 days (para 21, Schedule 6 ITA).

questions.question: What tax rate applies to a foreign national who is not tax resident in Malaysia?
questions.answer_notes: Section 4.5: residents taxed at scale rates with reliefs; non-residents at a flat rate without reliefs.

questions.question: What is the maximum value of each asset that qualifies for the small value asset special allowance?
questions.answer_notes: Each asset must not exceed RM2,000.

questions.question: Can I claim the special allowance for small value assets bought on hire purchase?
questions.answer_notes: No — section 13: special allowances do not apply to assets acquired on hire purchase; normal capital allowance instead.

questions.question: What does PR No. 4/2026 say about hire purchase?
questions.answer_notes: Same fact as q04, but asked by ruling number — tests identifier matching (known weakness of dense retrieval).

questions.question: How much tax relief can I claim for a child under 18?
What purchases qualify for lifestyle relief?
questions.answer_notes: Section 6.11: books/journals/magazines/newspapers, personal computer/smartphone/tablet, internet subscription, skills courses.

questions.question: What conditions must be met to claim tax relief for breastfeeding equipment?
questions.answer_notes: Section 6.12.3: breastfeeding mother, child up to 2 years, equipment for own use, receipts.

questions.question: How long does a buyer have to reject an e-invoice after it has been validated?
questions.answer_notes: Within 72 hours from validation, via MyInvois Portal.

questions.question: When must businesses with annual turnover between RM5 million and RM25 million start issuing e-invoices?
How much service tax is charged on a credit card?
questions.answer_notes: RM25 per card on activation and every 12 months thereafter.

questions.question: Is service tax charged on financial services imported from a foreign provider?
questions.answer_notes: Imported taxable financial services section (paragraph 28 onwards).

questions.question: Which private education providers are subject to service tax from 1 July 2025?
questions.answer_notes: Paragraph 22: private playschools, kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, tuition and learning centres, international and expatriate schools.

questions.question: Do Malaysian students pay service tax on private university fees?
questions.answer_notes: No — higher education is taxed only for non-Malaysian students.

questions.question: What is the GST rate in Singapore?
How do I calculate real property gains tax when I sell my house?
questions.answer_notes: Out of scope, Malaysian tax but not in these documents (near-domain).
